basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Seattle, WA, with a passion for stealth video games, especially the Dishonored series. I love connecting with fellow fans and discussing game lore. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy exploring local coffee shops and writing short stories. I'm in a relationship and my partner shares my love for narrative-driven games. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, and I've been a passionate gamer since I was a kid. I often delve into game design and storytelling techniques, learning from both formal education and personal experience.
